{{Quote|Using a lightsaber is just as much science as art.|Master Zhin|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Zhin''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]]<ref name="TOR" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi instructor|instructor]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Zhin had [[Color/Legends|brown]] skin, green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and black [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. They carried a single [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] with the [[Belt/Legends|belt]] of their dark brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Zhin appears on [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-occupied [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Given that Act II of the [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] storyline occurs on Republic-occupied Taris, as established in {{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Architect of Annihilation|Taris}}, and Act II takes place in [[3642 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TOR dates/2|here]], Zhin must have been present on Taris at about the same [[Time/Legends|time]].</ref> Zhin was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], where they lived in [[Olaris]], the headquarters of the Republic's [[Taris Resettlement Initiative|resettlement project]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master Zhin appeared as a trainer for players of the Jedi Knight class in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
